fn all_positive(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Bool =
  let start = if i < 0 then len(xs) else i in
  let end = if i >= len(xs) then len(xs) else i + 1 in
  fold(range(start, end), false, fn(a: Bool, x: Int) => a && xs[x] >= 0)
test all_positive_yes = all_positive([1, 2], 0)
test all_positive_no = !all_positive([1, -2], 0)

fn rot13(s: Str) -> Str =
  let n = from_int(from_str(s)) in
  let r = map(range(0, len(s)), fn(i) => to_str(from_int(i + n))) in
  from_list(r)

test rot13_ok = rot13("Hello") == "Uryyb"
